sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今天的主要事件：

  • August PCE release at 8:30: The market expects both headline and core PCE to rise +0.3% month over month, with year-over-year increases of approximately 3.7% and 3.3%, respectively. The BEA will make its annual revisions, including a measurement correction to the “computer software and accessories” category. The Fed estimates this correction could lower the annualized core PCE growth rate by about 0.16 percentage points. Treasury yields remain near their highest levels since 2007. TLT closed Tuesday at 78.24 (-0.50%). The data had not been released as of 08:14.
  • MU reports FQ4 earnings after the close today: Consensus estimates call for revenue of approximately $51.2 billion (+352% year over year) and EPS of approximately $31.6. MU closed Tuesday at 1064.975 (+1.04%) and was quoted at 1065.92 (+0.09%) premarket. SNDK closed Tuesday at 1729.975 (+1.05%).
  • Month-end and quarter-end rebalancing: Goldman estimates that U.S. pension funds will sell approximately $33 billion in equities around month-end, an amount at the 98th percentile since 2000. Potential CTA buying ranges from $11.5 billion to $29.9 billion. The three major indexes diverged Tuesday: SPY closed at 764.38 (-0.15%), QQQ at 737.96 (+0.19%), and IWM fell 0.34%. Premarket, QQQ was +0.13% and IWM +0.06%.
  • Executive order renaming “AI” to “SI” signed; tech stocks continue to diverge: Federal agencies must now use the term “Super Intelligence/SI.” META rose 3.27% Tuesday to close at 738.96; AAPL fell 2.61% to 329.58. Meanwhile, reports said new CEO Ternus was planning layoffs and cuts to some projects because of rising memory costs. FICO plunged 26.67% in a single day to close at 617.29 after the FHFA allowed Fannie and Freddie to incorporate VantageScore into uniform pricing.
